title: Understanding Boolean Featurization
text: In the boolean featurization, each food item is represented by a column, and a value of $$1$$ indicates that the food was eaten, while $$0$$ indicates it was not. This means the matrix only shows whether a food was consumed, not how many servings were eaten.

title: Analyzing Feature Vectors
text: Consider what the sum of a feature vector represents in the context of boolean featurization. Does it account for the number of servings or just the presence of the food?
